package_info.package_manager: N/A (malicious Windows executable, not a package manager ecosystem)
package_info.why_malicious: QNodeService is a Trojan delivered via Coronavirus-themed phishing campaigns, masquerading as a COVID-19 tax relief tool. It is designed to establish a backdoor, exfiltrate data, and enable remote control of infected systems.

execution_context.file_location: malicious Windows executable delivered as email attachment

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Upon execution, the malware establishes a connection to a command-and-control (C2) server, downloads additional payloads, and executes commands received from the attacker.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code connects to a remote C2 server, downloads and executes additional payloads, and allows remote command execution, enabling full system compromise.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Establishing a C2 channel and executing remote commands is a hallmark of backdoor Trojans.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Normal executables do not connect to remote servers for command execution or download further malware.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Remote administration tools (RATs) may have similar behavior in enterprise environments, but are never distributed via phishing.
key_indicators: Network connection to attacker-controlled C2 server
Execution of arbitrary commands from remote source

attack_chain.action: Victim receives phishing email promising COVID-19 tax relief and is lured to download and execute the malicious file.
QNodeService establishes a connection to the attacker's C2 server.
attack_chain.leads_to: Remote command execution and further payload delivery

attack_chain.action: Attacker issues commands to the infected system, potentially exfiltrating data or installing additional malware.
attack_chain.leads_to: Full system compromise and data theft

behavioral_signatures: Executable delivered via COVID-19 themed phishing email
Unexpected outbound connections to known C2 infrastructure
Process spawning and execution of downloaded payloads
file_indicators: Suspicious executable attachments with COVID-19 or tax relief themes
Files dropped in temporary or user directories after execution
network_indicators: Outbound connections to domains/IPs associated with QNodeService C2
Unusual traffic patterns immediately after opening suspicious attachments
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for execution of email attachments with COVID-19 or tax-related filenames, detect outbound connections to known QNodeService C2 infrastructure, and alert on processes that download and execute additional payloads after initial execution.
